1.why: P1 ends on ledge below the obvious roof, up and right past small tree
1.text: Belay on the ledge up and right of the small tree, directly under the big roof.

2.why: P2: turn lip, ~12 ft more to belay ledge; gear anchor; trimmed unsupported detail
2.text: After turning the lip of the roof, climb about twelve feet more to a ledge; the belay there takes thin gear.

3.why: P3 ends on large treed ledge after the dihedral, rope reaches it
3.text: The pitch ends on a large ledge with trees, reached after the dihedral; a full rope length gets you there.

8.why: P8 short chimney back and left to a better ledge, belay there
8.text: Back and left up the short chimney to a roomy ledge that is better than the one below.

P1.why: P1: step right around blind arete to bolted anchor
P1.text: Bolted anchor just past the blind arete, reached by stepping right after the pale slab.

P2.why: P2: traverse right on ledge, belay at base of main slab
P2.text: Belay at the foot of the main slab, after following the ledge off to the right.

P8.why: P8: easy off-width then belay at top
P8.text: Belay at the top of the easy off-width that finishes the route.
